nullable_error.semantics: error:null is absence of API error; only non-null error values are fail-closed

structured_output.repair: translate {response_format:{type:json_object}} into {text:{format:{type:json_object}}} only on the Sol Responses live wire payload

probe_policy.purpose: tiny Responses transport/accounting gate before any full Sol benchmark request
probe_policy.error_handling: missing error key or error:null is non-error; any non-null object/scalar/list error stops and is sanitized
probe_policy.missing_usage_behavior: stop before the full benchmark call and mark spend UNKNOWN/unreconciled unless exact usage is present

accounting_policy.successful_live_envelope: record exact recursively discovered usage and estimated cost before visible-final-text parsing
accounting_policy.error_envelope: non-null errors never proceed to scoring; account exact usage if exposed, otherwise keep spend UNKNOWN/unreconciled
accounting_policy.arbitrary_error_text: never retain raw provider error strings; retain only SHA-256, length and allowlisted diagnostic markers

architecture_snapshot_policy: retain the same canonical ACCB-DEV-001 snapshot used by the first four scores so a later fifth score remains directly comparable; A/B/C/D expansion is a later preregistered tranche
provider_policy: pin the OpenAI endpoint tag; allow_fallbacks=false; record actual provider metadata returned by RouterAI

admission_policy: Sol must expose a healthy Responses endpoint >=128K and positive parseable pricing; existing <=100 RUB upper bound remains; tiny probe must return no non-null error plus exact token usage before the expensive live request
